Lena Kask, finance manager, joined and signed off on price. Agreement going today: Supply from October, three supplier blocks from January (Lena's request, no farm letters before the six products). 21,400 total. Inflation cap at renewal.

The customer moved the six product deadline to end of October after Stefan wrote to the category buyer. She thanked him for asking.

Stefan asked "and then what". Used Karin's "what happens next" page for the first time. First two points fit perfectly: first twenty farms then the next dozen, and a review of each of the two sites (Stefan already has meters per ripening room). The tiebreak rule does not fit a dairy: Bertil pointed out they take all their members' milk, there is no tender between farms. It fits packaging (tender every two years, next in spring). For milk the equivalent is a premium per litre for practice, which is their board's decision, not ours. The page needs a line for cooperatives.

Lena's three risk questions on the one pager were the best part of the call. The production planner is on paternity leave from November; the head cheesemaker does the recipe sessions instead.

Two target paragraph: told them again we measure both parts but don't set targets or pathways. Going on the plan as an open question.
